The Chinese medicinal composition mainly comprises the following raw material medicaments: Chinese eaglewood, rosewood heart wood, radish seed, lesser galangal rhizome, dried ginger, rhubarb, golden thread, immature bitter orange, tangerine peel, green tangerine peel, grassleaf sweelflag rhizome, benzoin, fenugreek lysimachia, storax, magnetite, cinnabar, red ochre, semen trichosanthis, common burreed rhizome, zedoary, pangolin scales, ground beeltle, cowherb seed, safflower, peach seed, rhizoma corydalis, szechuan lovage rhizome, radix curcumae, roasted frankincense, roasted myrrh, Jiuxiang bug, szechwan chinaberry fruit, cyperusrotundus and the like. The Chinese medicinal composition can be prepared into any one common orally-taken preparation by a conventional Chinese medicinal preparation method. The Chinese medicinal composition can remarkably improve the symptoms: gas channeling in lower abdomen, priming in abdominal cavity, vibration in diaphragm, swelling in chest and abdomen, priming, vibrating, tenesmus, inner pain, swelling pain, top channeling, liver and lung lifting, pain suffering and the like, and has extract clinical treatment effect, remarkable treatment effect and quick response.

title: Medicine composition for treating burn wound and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to medicine composition for treating burn wound and a preparation method thereof. The medicine composition consists of angelica dahurica, radix paeoniae rubra, radix scrophulariae, rhubarb, radix rehmanniae, angelica, cortex phellodendri, salivia chinensis, rhizoma coptidis, szechuan lovage rhizome, radix paeoniae alba and vegetable oil. The preparation method comprises the steps: placing the angelica dahurica, the radix paeoniae rubra, the radix scrophulariae, the rhubarb, the radix rehmanniae, the angelica, the cortex phellodendri, the salivia chinensis, the rhizoma coptidis, the szechuan lovage rhizome, the radix paeoniae alba and the vegetable oil into a gauze after oil-immersion, mixing, heating and filtering. The medicine composition belongs to the secret recipe of the pure Chinese Traditional medicine, uses traditional medicine materials as raw materials and is prepared by adopting scientific proportion so as to dredge the channels and collaterals, remove pattogenic heat from the blood and toxic material from the body, activate blood and dissolve stasis, relieve swelling and pain and remove the rotten and let fresh grow, recover energy with biochemical operation, activate metabolism and enhance self-immunity function so that the surface of the wound hurt by the burn wound can obtain regenerative repair. The medicine composition can be used for treating various kinds of fire burn, scalding, trauma, abscess, bedsore, scarring and angiitis, various kinds of skin infections, and the like. Due to no pain for treating the burn injury without skin graft, smooth wound surface treated in third-degree burn injury, no obvious scar, the medicine composition is an external treatment with no toxity, no incitement, no senitization, safe and good healing efficacy, and can be applied to emergency treatment for burn injury.

title: Chinese medicinal pill for treating lumbar and leg pain
abstract: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicinal pill composition for treating waist and leg pains, wherein the active constituents comprise pawpaw 10-15g, cyathula root each 10-15g, frankincense 10-15g, myrrh 10-15g, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 10-15g, processed semen strychni 10-15g, wild aconkite root 8-10g, homalomena rhizome 4-5g, Chinese ephedra 8-10g, Chinese pulsatilla root 10-15g and ledebouriella root 15-20g.

title: Medicine compounds for pulmonary and rheumatic heart disease and preparing method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a medical combination for treating pulmonary heart disease and rheumatic heart disease and the preparation method thereof the invention is prepared by peach kernel, safflower, angelica, charles abraham, Szechwan Lovage Rhizome, red peony root, achyranthes root, balloonflower root, bupleurum, citrus aurantium, and licorice. The medical combination of the invention has the efficacy of activating blood, promoting qi and ending pains, mainly for the treatment of pulmonary heart disease, rheumatic heart disease, the chest pain and headache caused by the clotted blood and the unsmooth blood flow in the chest, and also for coronary angina pectoris, chest contusion, rib chondritis chest pain, neurosis, deprementia of the concussion of brain sequela, dizziness headache, and other diseases. The invention has the advantages of simple formula, easy production, convenient taking by the patients, obvious efficacy, and wide application value.

title: Chinese medicinal compound preparation for treating coronary heart disease and angina
abstract: The invention discloses Chinese medicinal compound preparation for treating coronary heart disease and angina. The Chinese medicinal compound preparation is granular formulation, capsule formulation and tablet formulation which are prepared from the following 12 kinds of Chinese medicinal materials in certain proportion by weight: danshen root, golden thread, membranous milkvetch root, kudzuvine root, szechuan lovage rhizome, rhodiola rosea, yanhusuo, ginkgo leaf, Chinese honeylocust spine, safflower, nutgrass galingale rhizome and red paeony root. The compound preparation has effects of activating blood circulation to dissipate blood stasis, tonifying qi, relieving pain and nourishing kidney-Yin, and can be used for treating the coronary heart disease, the angina and symptoms of chest distress, chest pain, cardiopalmus, dizziness, insomnia, tinnitus, lassitude in the loin and knees and the like. In addition, the medicament of the compound preparation has the characteristics of high bioavailability and obvious curative effect.

title: Medicament for treating mammary gland hyperplasia
abstract: The invention discloses a medicament for treating mammary gland hyperplasia, which is prepared by extracting spica prunellae, szechuan lovage rhizome, radix bupleuri, Mongolian dandelion herb, suberect spatholobus stem, sadix notoginseng, figwort root, red paeony root, Chinese angelica, cowherb seed, thckahoe, dwarf lilyturf tuber, seaweed, and the like. The medicament has the efficacies of smoothing the liver and regulating qi, and softening hardness to dissipate stagnation, and is used for the mammary gland hyperplasia caused by qi stagnation and blood stasis and symptoms of the mammary gland hyperplasia are as follows: breast pain, breast lumps, agitation and irritation, distention in chest, and the like. The invention also discloses a preparation method for the medicament.

title: Health-care tea for diffusing impediment and relieving pain
abstract: The invention discloses health-care tea for diffusing impediment and relieving pain. Main components of the health-care tea consist of 50 grams of red ginseng, 100 grams of radix salviae miltiorrhizae, 100 grams of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 100 grams of panax pseudoginseng, 2 grams of pinellia tuber, 100 grams of radix curcumae, 50 grams of eaglewood, 3 grams of rhizome of Chinese monkshood, 30 grams of ephedra, 50 grams of monkshood, 30 grams of asarum, 100 grams of rhizoma corydalis, 8 grams of rhizoma atractylodis, 30 grams of borneol, and the like. A preparation method comprises the following steps: grinding the components into powder together, putting the powder into a bottle and sealing the bottle, wherein 3 grams of powder is taken out each time and taken with warm boiled water thrice every day. The health-care tea is prepared by pure Chinese medicaments, has no toxic and side effects, has the efficacies of tonifying qi and strengthening heart, aromatic herbs activating yang, removing blood stasis and relieving pain, and has no side effect.

title: Ointment for curing protrusion of lumbar vertebral disc, sciatica, pain of neck, shoulder and legs, rheumatoid arthritis and hyperosteogeny
abstract: The invention relates to an ointment for curing protrusion of lumbar vertebral disc, sciatica, pain of neck, shoulder and legs, rheumatoid arthritis and hyperosteogeny which can effectively solve treatments of protrusion of lumbar vertebral disc, sciatica, pain of neck, shoulder and legs, rheumatoid arthritis and hyperosteogeny and be prepared from asarum, notopterygium root, root of doubleteeth pubescent angelica, monkshood, cassia twig, centipede, rhizoma dioscoreae colletii, mistletoe, xanthoxylum, rhizome of szechuan lovage, turtle shell, borneol, papaya, scorpion, the root of bidentate achyranthes, garter snake, sesame oil and minimum. The preparation method of the ointment comprises the following steps: soaking the other drugs except minimum and borneol in sesame oil, frying the drugs to be shrivelled by using soft fire, filtrating to remove residues and obtain an oily medicine solution, placing the medicine solution in a medicine boiler to boil so as to ensure that the oil can form drops when dropped in water, then adding minimum to stir evenly, cooling, and adding borneol to obtain the finished product. The compatibility and dosage of the ointment of the invention are scientific and reasonable, the ointment is easy to produce, the cost is low and the curative effect is good so that the ointment can be used to effectively cure lumbar vertebral disc, sciatica, pain of neck, shoulder and legs, rheumatoid arthritis and hyperosteogeny and is a great innovation of traditional Chinese medicines.

title: Chinese patent medicament for treating painful swollen gum caused by wind cold
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese patent medicament for treating painful swollen gum caused by wind cold. The Chinese patent medicament is prepared from the following raw materials of Chinese angelica, szechuan lovage rhizome, liquorice root, white paeony root, manchurian wildginger, bitter orange, cassia twig, divaricate saposhnikovia root, platycodon root and perilla leaf as raw materials which are made into capsule, tablet, granule, and the like. The Chinese patent medicament has the effects of clearing heat and dispelling fire and diminishing inflammation and relieving pain, and has remarkable therapeutic effect of treating the painful swollen gum caused by the wind cold without generating toxic side effect.

title: Externally used medicinal liquor for massaging spondyle
abstract: The invention relates to an in vitro drug delivery and massage technology, and the in vitro drug directly sends an effective drug to the focus part by the in vitro supply, thereby leading the drug to play the effect and achieving the purpose of preventing and treating a disease. The drug name is spinal massage medicated wine (externally applied) and the ingredients comprise: liquor for drinking, herb of smallflower bracketplant, common burreed rhizome, sanchi, Szechuan lovage rhizome, ground beetle, costustoot, dahurian angelica root, zedoary, tangerine peel, Chinese angelica, pharbitis seed (stir-fried), safflower, officinal magnolia bark (processed with ginger), Chinese honeylocust abnormal fruit, areca seed, and the like, as well as soda ash (a guiding drug). The functions and the indications are as follows: the drug has the functions of relieving rigidity of muscles, promoting blood circulation, regulating qi and blood, regulating channels, promoting blood circulation, dispersing blood stasis, relieving pain, removing blood stasis for promoting tissue regeneration and strengthening muscles and bones and is mainly used for massage therapy of headache, spinal bone pain, spinal disc herniation and pain, tennis elbow, periarthritis of shoulder, osteonecrosis of the femoral head, pain, soreness, swelling and numbness of limbs and joints, and the like caused by wind-cold and damp-evil or injuries from falls, fractures, contusions and strains and recurrence of old injuries.

title: Medicinal composition for curing necrosis of femoral head and preparation thereof
abstract: The present invention provides a medicine composition for treating femoral head necrosis, which is prepared from Chinese traditional medicines including angelica, szechuan lovage rhizome, yanhusuo, olibanum, myrrh, tangerine peel, curcuma, pubescent angelica, root of dahuriae angelica, cassia twig, rhizomadrynariae, japanese teasel, woodwardia japonica etc. The medicine composition treats femoral head necrosis with functions of supplying and benefiting to liver and kidney, warming and dredging collaterals, activating blood and dredging collaterals. The medicine composition has merits of non-toxic side effect, material easy obtained, low cost, better cure effect, and can avoid pain and wound in operation, has wide application value.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine formulation for treating migraine
abstract: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating migraine, and the formula thereof comprises: 7-10g of scorpion, 10-15g of kudzuvine root, 10-15g of earthworm, 7-10g of incised notopterygium rhizome, 7-10g of centipede, 7-12g of tall gastrodia tuber, 15-30g of sea-ear shell, 10-20g of stiff silkworm, 10-15g of peach seed, 10-15g of safflower, 10-15g of white paeony root, 15-30g of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 10-15g of dahurian angelica root, 7-10g of liquoric root and 10-15g of divaricate saposhnikovia root. The formula has the effects of activating blood circulation, removing blood stasis, dredging channels and relieving pain and the formula can treat the migraine caused by collateral obstruction due to blood stasis.

title: Antiphlogistic and analgesic ointment
abstract: The invention relates to antiphlogistic and analgesic ointment, and belongs to the technical field of Chinese medicine. Active components of the ointment comprise two parts, namely, one part comprises the following materials in portion by weight: 15 to 25 portions of Szechwan lovage rhizome, 25 to 35 portions of radix salviae miltiorrhizae, 8 to 12 portions of rhizoma drynariae, 8 to 12 portions of unprocessed radix aconiti, 8 to 12 portions of unprocessed kusnezoff monkshood root, 15 to 25 portions of frankincense, 15 to 25 portions of myrrh, 15 to 25 portions of black ants, 15 to 25 portions of rhizoma corydalis, 15 to 25 portions of panax notoginseng, 25 to 35 portions of spina gleditsiae, 25 to 35 portions of scorpion, 10 to 20 portions of safflower, 8 to 12 portions of parsnip, 25 to 35 portions of cortex periplocae, 40 to 60 portions of Oleum terebinthinae, 15 to 25 portions of radix clematis, 8 to 12 portions of rhizoma corydalis, 15 to 25 portions of cortex albiziae, 15 to 25 portions of radix curcumae, 25 to 35 portions of radix linderae, 15 to 25 portions of common burreed rhizome, 15 to 25 portions of rhizoma zedoary, 25 to 35 portions of dried ginger, 10 to 20 portions of coralbean bark, 10 to 20 portions of calamus, 25 to 35 portions of camphor and 5 to 15 portions of borneol and the other part comprises the following materials in terms of using amount: 4 to 6 centipedes, 90 to 110 inches of peach twig, 90 to 110 inches of elm twig, 90 to 110 inches of mulberry twig, 90 to 110 inches of willow twig and 90 to 110 inches of pagoda tree twig. The ointment adopts new composition, is scientific and reasonable, and has quick and good curative effect.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for curing hyperosteogeny and preparation thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine combination for remedying the hyperosteogeny. The traditional Chinese medicine combination is made from clematis root, common burred tuber, black tail snake, earthworm, safflower, dried rehmannia root, centipede, liquorice, salvia, zedoary rhizome, atractylodes rhizome, Szechwan lovage rhizome, monkshood and/or acceptable carriers in pharmacology. The present invention also relates to the preparation method of the traditional Chinese medicine combination. The traditional Chinese medicine combination of the present invention has the effects of removing stasis for expulsing pathogen, reinforcing kidney for softening firmness, relaxing tendons, removing obstruction in channels, etc. and is used for such as the symptoms of local pain, stiff, posterior root neuralgia, numbness caused by the hyperosteogeny.

title: Medicinal composition used for treating pelvic inflammatory disease and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a medicinal composition used for treating pelvic inflammatory disease and a preparation method thereof. The composition is prepared from the following raw materials in portion by weight: 10 to 40 portions of danshen root, 10 to 30 portions of Chinese angelica, 10 to 30 portions of medcinal evodia fruit, 10 to 30 portions of tree peony bark, 10 to 30 portions of red paeony root, 5 to 20 portions of zedoary, 5 to 20 portions of common burreed rhizome, 5 to 20 portions of szechuan lovage rhizome and 10 to 30 portions of glossy privet fruit which can be made into clinically acceptable medicament forms including tablet, capsule, granule and soft capsule, and the like through adopting modern preparation techniques. The medicinal composition has the efficacies of activating blood circulation to dissipate blood stasis, rectifying qi and relieving pain, softening hardness and eliminating fullness and warming uterus and nourishing kidney moreover, the medicinal composition has exact therapeutic effect of treating pelvic inflammatory disease which has the symptoms of abdominal distending pain or stabbing pain, lumbosacral distending pain, leucorrhea increase along with yellow color and thin texture, fatigued spirit and lack of strength, menstrual disorder and dysmenorrhoea.

title: Chinese medicament coaptation capsule and preparation method
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicament coaptation capsule and a preparation method. The capsule is prepared from rare Chinese medicaments including peach kernel, safflower, szechuan lovage rhizome, olibanum, myrrh, rhizoma corydalis, achyranthes root, dried body of ground beetle, sanguis draxonis, angelica, native copper, eucommia, himalayan teasel root, drynaria rhizome, gardenia, plantain seed, bark of boxthorn root, slenderstyle acanthopanax bark, fruit of citron, divaricate saposhnikovia root and angelica root according to a certain proportion. The Chinese medicament coaptation capsule has the functions of dispelling stasis, alleviating pain, relaxing muscles and tendons and reunion of fracture moreover, when used for treating fracture patients, the capsule ensures the repair and regeneration of tissues of a fracture part and promotes blood circulation, thereby quickening fracture healing.

title: Ointment for treating rheumatism, cold arthralgia and traumatic injury
abstract: The invention discloses an ointment for treating rheumatism, cold arthralgia and traumatic injury, which is prepared by adopting the following medicinal materials: 20 to 50g of frankincense, 20 to 50g of myrrh, 5 to 25g of pseudo-ginseng, 5 to 20g of safflower, 5 to 20g of radix angelicae, 5 to 20g of radix angelicae pubescentis, 5 to 20g of divaricate saposhnikovia root, 5 to 20g of manchurian wildginger, 5 to 20g of gentiana macrophylla, 5 to 25g of szechuan lovage rhizome, 5 to 20g of rheum officinale, 5 to 20g of Chinese honeylocust fruit, 5 to 20g of ephedra herb and 5 to 15g of dragon's blood all the above medicinal materials are cleaned, ground into medicinal powder, poured into 50% to 65% wine, soaked for 15 days, deslagged, extracted and then the ointment is obtained. The ointment has both nourishing effect and absorbing effect, has the functions of applying cold and warm, expelling wind and removing dampness, warming and activating meridian, activating blood and dissolving stasis, relieving swelling and pain, and eliminating blood stasis and promoting tissue regeneration and the ointment can be directly used at the injured parts, can directly reach focus, has strong effect for sterilizing and dissolving stasis, and can eliminate pain.

title: Medicine for treating spondylose cervicale radiculaire
abstract: The invention relates to a medicine for treating spondylose cervicale radiculaire, which takes radix astragali, Chinese angelica, szechuan lovage rhizome, chrysanthemum, selfheal, the root of red-rooted salvia, rhizoma curcumae longae, the fruit of Chinese wolfberry, mulberry twig, radix paeoniae alba, pinellia tuber, rhizoma cibotii, Chinese holly leaf, the root of kudzu vine and liquorice as rawmaterials the raw materials are added with water and decocted to be concentrated into thick paste after that, the thick paste is dried and ground, and then is filled into capsules finally, after being sterilized, the capsule product can be prepared. The medicine has the functions of tonifying kidney and strengthening bone, nourishing blood and dredging the channels and collaterals, expelling wind and removing damness as well as relieving spasm and pain, can be used for treating the spondylose cervicale radiculaire, and has the characteristics of reliable, rapid and convenient treating effect as well as safe taking. Through clinical observation, the total effective rate is 100%.

title: Medicinal liquor preparations for curing stagnation and blood stasis chest stuffiness and pain
abstract: The invention relates to a medicated wine preparation for curing the obstruction of qi in the chest and chest pain caused by cold phlegm, stagnation of the vital energy, blood stasis and retinervus blocking, which is composed of the drugs of Mongolian snakegourd, bulb of long stamen onion, cassia twig, asarum, Chinese angelica root-tip, rhizome of Sichuan lovage, red sage root, curcuma root, cyperirhizome, corydalis tuber, powder of notoginseng, licorice, cereal wine and so on. The invention is used for preventing and curing the obstruction of qi in the chest and chest pain caused by cold phlegm, stagnation of the vital energy, blood stasis and retinervus blocking. The medicated wine preparation has the advantages that the raw materials are extensive, the preparation is simple, the oral administration is convenient, the targeting force is strong, the guiding force is strong, the curative effect is good, toxic and side effects do not exist, and the total effective rate of the clinical expectant treatment is 100 percent, and the gap that the medicated wine has the functions of warming heart-yang, regulating vital energy, facilitating qi, resolving phlegm, promoting blood circulation to dispel blood stasis, relieving the cold and alleviating pain, and the field blank of curing the obstruction of qi in the chest and chest pain is filled up. The invention is an innovation of the clinical medical care medicated wine culture for the diseases such as obstruction of qi in the chest and chest pain of human beings at present.

title: Chinese medicament preparation for treating cholecystitis and gall-stone as well as preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating cholecystitis and gallstones and a preparation method thereof. The main pharmaceutical raw materials and the proportioning by weight are as follows: 18-80 parts of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 18-80 parts of Chinese thorowax, 18-80 parts of costus root, 28-140 parts of yellow croaker ear-stone, 18-80 parts of immature bitter orange, 18-80 parts of officinal magnolia bark, 28-140 parts of Chinese angelica, 18-80 parts of golden thread and 18-80 parts of liquoric root. The preparation method comprises: 1. medicinal materials are washed, wherein, the Chinese angelica is processed with wine, and the yellow croaker ear-stone is calcined 2. the yellow croaker ear-stone is dried and smashed into medicine powder 3. the other medicinal materials are dried and smashed into the medicine powder, water is added for soaking, filtrate generated by two times of decoction is merged, an extract is obtained, and the extract is concentrated to thick paste which is further smashed 4. the medicine powder of the step 2 and the step 3 is mixed 5. excipients are added for preparing capsules, tablets and so on. The traditional Chinese medicine preparation has significant therapeutic and analgesic effects for cholecystitis and gallstones, obvious efficacy, short treatment cycle and low recurrence rate.

title: Chinese medicament for treating cerebral thrombosis
abstract: The invention relates to a Chinese medicament for treating cerebral thrombosis, and belongs to the field of Chinese medicaments. The Chinese medicament for treating the cerebral thrombosis comprises the following active ingredients in part by weight: 10 to 20 parts of safflower, 15 to 20 parts of fructus citri immaturus exsiccatus, 10 to 20 parts of apricot kernel, 10 to 30 parts of astragalus, 4 to 10 parts of centipede, 10 to 20 parts of red paeony root, 5 to 10 parts of root of red-rooted salvia, 8 to 20 parts of myrrh, 5 to 10 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome and 10 to 20 parts of cortex cinnamomi. A large number of clinical experiments proves that the Chinese medicament has the effects of promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, promoting qi circulation and relieving pain and stopping blood, and has the advantages of good curative effect, short course of treatment, relapse prevention and high cure rate of over 95 percent.

title: Chinese thorowax Shugansan oral preparation and preparing method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an oral preparation of Chaihushugan powder, which is prepared with Chinese thorowax root and other six Chinese medicines mainly for treating stagnation of hepatic qi, and the preparation method thereof. The oral preparation is prepared according to conventional processes and utilizing the mixed extracts (extractum or drymeal and naphtha) of bupleurum, tangerine peel, szechuan lovage rhizome, nutgrass galingale rhizome, bitter orange, peony and radix glycyrrhizae preparata as raw materials, together with vector or excipient which are utilized as matrix and acceptable in pharmacy. The preparation has the effects of relieving liver qi stagnation, promoting qi and relieving pain, and mainly treats liver qi depression. The long-term clinical application of the prescription shows that the oral preparation has a good effect on chronic hepatitis, chronic gastritis and cholecystitis, etc.

title: Chinese medicine granule for treating various dysmenorrhea
abstract: The invention is a Chinese medicine granular used for treating various dysmenorrheal. The Chinese medicine granular is made by the following raw medicine materials by weight proportion: 10 to 20 portions of salvia miltiorrhiza, 5 to 10 portions of angelica, 5 to 10 portions of Zhixiangfu, 5 to 10 portions of rhizome corydalis, 5 to 10 portions of cassia twig, 5 to 10 portions of szechuan lovage rhizome, 5 to 10 portions of safflower, 10 to 15 portions of radix paeoniae lactiflorae, 10 to 15 portions of red paeony root and 15 to 30 portions of motherwort herb. The raw medicine materials are taken according to the weight proportion, extracted, concentrated and crashed into powder to obtain the granular. The Chinese medicine granular used for treating various dysmenorrheal has the functions of regulating Qi, activating blood, warm dredging, removing blood stasis, regulating menstruation and alleviating pain. The Chinese medicine granular used for treating various dysmenorrheal can treat various dysmenorrheal caused by syndrome of static blood blocking in uterine vessel resulting from stagnation of Qi, blood stasis, stagnation of blood and coagulation of coldness. Symptoms are as follows: hypogastric pain or cold pain appears before, after or during menstruation and pain can be alleviated by warmness engorgement of breast, scanty bleeding or bleeding difficulty with dark menses and blood coagulum appears, and pain can be alleviated after blood coagulum is removed or coated tongue is white and thin tongue proper is dark or has petechia and pulse is slow or sunken.

title: Pure Chinese medicinal preparation for activating blood circulation, removing blood stasis and relieving pain
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicinal preparation for relieving pains caused by various chronic diseases and wounds, wherein the raw material include the following constituents (by weight ratio): cattail pollen 10-50, trogopterus dung 10-50, rhizoma corydalis 10-50, curcuma root 10-50, sandalwood 10-25, notoginseng 10-50, radix salvia miltiorrhiza 10-50, curcuma longa 10-30, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 10-30, amber 10-30 and borneol 1-10.

title: Chinese traditional medicine named numb pain resolvent for treating diabetes peripheral nervous lesion
abstract: The invention relates to a Chinese traditional medicine named numb pain resolvent for treating diabetes peripheral nervous lesion, which comprises the following raw materials (by weight portion), Achyranthes bidentatae 10-30 parts, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 10-20 parts, rhizoma corydalis 10-1 parts, root bark of tree peony 10-20 parts, red peony root 10-20 parts, white peony root 10-30 parts, Chinese ephedra 5-15 parts and levisticum 3-10 parts.

title: Chinese traditional medicine composition for treating and preventing gout and method of making the same
abstract: The present invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition, in particular to the traditional Chinese medicine composition for the treatment and prevention of gout, which is prepared by the raw materials of eucommia bark, Indian iphigenia bulb, swordlike atractylodes rhizome, Chinese angelica, prepared common monkshood mother root, fineleaf schizonepeta herb, dendrobium, liquoric root, Szechuan lovage rhizome, tall gastrodia tuber, stiff silkworm and divaricate saposhnikovia root with certain mix ratio by weight. The present invention can be prepared into any commonly used preparation for internal use. The present invention has special formula and the functions of clearing heat-toxin, dispelling pathogenic wind and the dampness, arresting wind, removing stagnation, dredging meridian passage, relieving swelling, alleviating pain and so on the present invention can generate the effects of anti-inflammatory, easing pain, removing sweat, promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, thus having unique efficacy against the red, swollen, fever and pain of the joints. The present invention is mainly used for the treatment and prevention of gout, hyperuricemia and other diseases, the efficacy is fast and the treatment effect is significant.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for curing gland hyperplasia and method of preparing the same
abstract: The invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for the treatment of breast hyperplasia. The pharmaceutical composition is prepared by myrrh, safflower, Chinese angelica, nutgrass galingale rhizome, fructus forsythiae, liquoric root, tangerine seed, rhubarb, south dodder seed, Mongolian dandelion herb, common selfheal fruit-spike, Chinese thorowax root, snakegourd fruit, kelp, suberect spatholobus stem, Chinese taxillus twig, lychee seed, Szechuan lovage rhizome, hiraute shiny bugleweed herb, mirabilite and/or pharmaceutical acceptable carrier. The invention also relates to a method for preparing the pharmaceutical composition. With the effects of promoting blood circulation, removing blood stasis, softening and resolving hard masses, relieving depression of liver-qi and so on, the pharmaceutical composition of the invention can be used for treating cyclical breast pain and other symptoms due to the breast hyperplasia.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating hemorrhoids and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicinal composition for treating hemorrhoids and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition mainly comprises the following raw material medicaments: hops, pagodatree pod, pagodatree flower bud, Indian buead, lightyellow sophora root, figwort root, swordlike atractylodes rhizome, large-headed atractylodes rhizome, cinnamomvine, ground beeltle, szechwan chinaberry fruit, catechu, pyrite, Jiuxiang bug, szechuan lovage rhizome, Chinese eaglewood, rosewood heart wood, charred Chinese arborvitae twig, garden burnet root, gleditsia thorn, pangolin scales, double blossom, violet, sinkiang arnebia root, mongolian dandelion herb, weeping forsythiae capsule, raw astragalus, Chinese angelica, root of red-rooted salvia, pilose asiabell root, tree peony bark, gardenia, mongolian snakegourd root, baical skullcap root, golden thread, tinea alba skin, ash bark, red paeony root, pariphyllin, natural indigo, dahurian patrinia herb, Chinese lobelia herb and the like. The Chinese medicinal composition can be prepared into any one common orally-taken preparation by a conventional Chinese medicinal preparation method. The Chinese medicinal composition can remarkably improve the symptoms: blood stool, pain and prolapse of hemorrhoids, increased secretion caused thereby, discomfort with wet and damp anus, infection, tumefaction, pain and other symptoms, and has the advantages of extract clinical treatment effect, remarkable treatment effect and quick response.

title: Chinese medicinal compound effective component for treating gynecological diseases and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicinal compound effective component for treating gynecological diseases and a preparation method and application thereof. The effective component is prepared by obtaining water or ethanol extract of a Chinese medicinal compound consisting of Chinese angelica, Szechuan lovage rhizome, red paeony root, cattail pollen, trogopterus dung, myrrh and corydalis tuber, removing impurity through ethanol precipitation, then injecting the extract into a macroporous absorption resin column, and purifying the extract by gradient elution of ethanol with optimized concentration. A compatible raw material formula is selected according to the Chinese medicinal theory and the gynecological disease pathogenesis modern analysis instruments and pharmacological experiments show that the Chinese medicinal compound effective component provided by the invention has good activities of resisting uterine smooth muscle spasm, easing pain, resisting inflammation, adjusting estrogen and progestational hormone level, adjusting immunity and the like, can be used for treating multiple gynecological diseases such as primary dysmenorrhea, endometriosis, acute and chronic pelvic inflammation and the like, has clearer components and lower adverse reaction, and is expected to be developed as a new generation medicament for treating the gynecological diseases.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine for treating diabetic gastroparesis
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicines for treating diabetes mellitus, and provides a traditional Chinese medicine for treating diabetic gastroparesis, aiming at achieving good efficacy and rapid onset of action. The traditional Chinese medicine is prepared by nutgrass galingale rhizome, Szechuan lovage rhizome, sanchi, swordlike atractylodes rhizome, cape jasmine fruit, lucid ganoderma, Chinese thorowax root, turmeric root-tuber, Chinese angelica and other raw materials and has the effects of banking up root by strengthening vital qi, dispersing stagnated liver qi for relieving qi stagnation, regulating qi-flowing for eliminating mass, promoting blood circulation for removing blood stasis and relieving pain. The traditional Chinese medicine has good effect and rapid onset of action and is characterized by significant effect, exact efficacy and rapid onset of action.

title: Medicine for external application for gland hyperplasia
abstract: The invention belongs to the traditional Chinese medicine and concretely relates to an externally applied medicine for remedying the breast hyperplasia, which is characterized in that the externally applied medicine is made from 10g of turtle shell beads, 5g of dahurian angelica roots, 5g of (dried) common monkshood mother roots, 5g of cassia twigs, 5g of wormwood leaves, 5g of Szechwan lovage rhizome, 10g of Chinese clematis, 5g of droppings of flying squirrel and 10g of safflowers, which are dipped in 500ml of liquor for more than five days. The invention has the obvious advantages that the externally applied medicine is convenient for using the effect of medicine arrives at the affected part directly the medicine alleviates the pain promptly and acts fast without toxic and side effect the cost is low.

title: Medicament for curing cephalalgia and migraine and manufacture method thereof
abstract: A drug for treating headache and migraine and a preparation method thereof belong to the technology field of traditional Chinese medicine. The ingredients of the drug are manchurian wildginger, Szechuan lovage rhizome, dahurian angelica root, incised notopterygium rhizome and lesser galangal rhizome, and the drug is prepared by UV disinfecting, baking, smashing, screening, testing and packaging according to a reasonable mixing ratio. The drug has the effects of dispelling cold, stopping pain, promoting blood circulation, removing blood stasis and relieving exterior syndrome and the functions of warming interior syndrome, removing cold, warming kidney, restoring yang, regulating spleen and qi and relieving the head pain which is caused by wind, cold, summer and dampness. The using method is to spray or send the medicine powder into the nasal cavity, which can immediately produce the obvious effect, 5 to 15mg each time and 1 to 2 times per day, the head pain can be cured generally by continuous usage for 3 days, the total effective rate is 95 percent, the raw materials are wide, the production method is simple, the cost is low, the usage is convenient, thus avoiding the troubles of medication and injection and being applicable to the people at home, during travelling and field operation as the spare drug for treating the headache and the migraine.

title: Chinese medicine used for treating shoulder neck pain and lumbocrural pain and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicine (shoulder neck pain and lumbocrural pain eliminating liquid) used for treating shoulder neck pain and lumbocrural pain, and a preparation method thereof. The medicine consists of 9g of himalayan teasel root, 9g of dried tangerine peel, 9g of divaricate saposhnikovia root, 6g of eucommia bark, 6g of radix cyathulae, 9g of Chinese angelica, 6g of radix peucedani, 9g of Clematis chinensis, 6g of raidx astragali, 9g of radix paeoniae lactiflorae, 9g of rehmannia glutinosa, 9g of liquorice root, 9g of notopterygium incisum, 9g of szechuan lovage rhizome, 9g of straight ladybell root, 9g of cassia bark, 9g of medlar, 9g of medicinal indianmulberry root, 9g of Chinese taxillus twig, 500g of white sugar and 1000g of 55-degree liquor. The preparation method comprises the steps as follows: (1) the 19 medicines are put in a glass vessel (2) 500g of white sugar and 1000g of 55-degree liquor are mixed in the medicine vessel which is placed for seven days after being sealed and (3) medicinal liquor is taken out, and the cleaning solution is filtered out and put into bottles of 300ml and a suction cup and an acupuncture pin are distributed simultaneously. The shoulder neck pain and lumbocrural pain eliminating liquid has the functions of activating meridians and stopping pain, dispelling wind and eliminating dampness, replenishing vital energy and nourishing blood, and strengthening muscle and bone, and is mainly used for treating sore swelling, numbness, pain and the like caused by scapulohumeral periarthritis, arthritis, lumbar muscle strain, lumbocrural pain, sciatica, cervical spondylosis, lumbar vertebra disease, hyperosteogeny of four limb joints, thus being a medicine with short treatment course, quick effect and high curative ratio.

title: Specific analgesic patch
abstract: The invention provides multi-character paste, in particular to a multi-character paste for treating rheumatism, rheumatoid arthritis, cervical vertebra disease, lumbar disease, sciatica, hydrarthrosis and scapulohumeral periarthritis. One dosage of the paste comprises the following components: 40 grams of wooly datchmanspipe herb, 40 grams of garden balsam stem, 50 grams of szechuan lovage rhizome, 50 grams of creepers, 40 grams of large-leaved gentian, 30 grams of frankincense, 30 grams of myrrh, 50 grams of root of bidentate achyranthes, 50 grams of eupolyphaga, 40 grams of dragon's blood, 40 grams of rhizoma corydalis, 60 grams of polygonum multiflorum, 60 grams of bark of eucommia, 60 grams of drynaria rhizome, 60 grams of golden buckwheat rhizome, 30 grams of india madder root, 60 grams of acanthopanax root, 50 grams of caulis piperis futokadsurae, 50 grams of cynanchum paniculatum, 60 grams of obscured homalomena rhizome and 60 grams of balsamine, the total weight of which is 2jins, 3.5 jins of sesame oil, and 1.4 jins of miniumite. When the paste is prepared, the sesame oil is cooked and boiled first in a pot, then medicaments are added to be fried into char shape decoction dreg is spooned out, and the miniumite is put into the pot to be decocted to a state that decoction is shaped into ball the prepared paste is dipped in cool water for 7 days and the multi-character paste is heated to be soft when the paste is used, is applied to the middle of a cloth, and then the side with the paste of the cloth is applied to a related part on a human body.

title: Medicament for treating flab pain
abstract: The invention discloses a drug for remedying the soft tissue ache, which is characterized by consisting of the raw materials with the following weight portion of 10 to 20 portion of roots of Chinese alangium, 7 to 15 portion of gambir plant roots, 7 to 15 portion of angelica tails, 10 to 20 portion of purple danshen, 5 to 10 portion of prepared frankincense, 5 to 10 portion of myrrh, 6 to 12 portion of corydalis rhizome, 17 to 35 portion of white peony roots, 10 to 20 portion of roasted liquorice, 7 to 15 portion of common Japanese clubmoss, 2 to 3 portion of unprepared ephedra, 9 to 18 portion of prepared roots of rehmannia, 2 to 4 portion of safflower and 6 to 12 portion of Szechwan lovage rhizome. The invention has the advantages that the comprehensive function of each medicine is used to effectively remedy various types of soft tissue ache the treatment period is short the cure rate is high the invention does not cause pain and wound the invention is convenient, comfort and safe for using the production technology is simple the cost is low.

title: Traditional Chinese traditional medicine composite for dispelling wind, activating blood circulation, stopping pain and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicine technology, in particular to a traditional Chinese medicine combination of dispelling wind and activating collaterals, alleviating pain and improving intelligence and a preparation method thereof. The components and the parts by weight of the traditional Chinese medicine combination are: 50-250 shares of Angelicadahurica, 50-250 shares of flower bud of lily magnolia, 100-400 shares of ligustilide, 50-150 shares of rhizome of Sichuan lovage, 100-400 shares of root kudzuvine, 10-80 shares of asarum herb, 100-400 shares of glossy privet fruit, 100-400 shares of motherwort fruit, 1-25ml schizonepeta spike oil. The invention has the advantages that the technical skill is simple, the operation is convenient, the quality can be controlled, the healing effect can be exerted fully, the dose is reasonable, the medicine is portable and is convenient for carrying the invention has remarkable economic benefit and social benefit and is suitable for industrial production.

title: Chinese prepared medicine for treating bone pain
abstract: The invention discloses a prepared traditional Chinese medicinal preparation for easing pain, which compirses the following raw materials (by weight portions): Chinese angelica root 15-25 parts, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 15-25 parts, astragalus root 20-30 parts, eucommia bark 25-35 parts, levisticum 15-25 parts, cyathula root 15-25 parts, dipsacus root 15-25 parts, ledebouriella root 15-25 parts, cinnamon twig 15-25 parts, herba schizonepetae 15-25 parts, Chinese ephedra 5-15 parts, atractylodes rhizome 10-20 parts, licorice root 5-15 parts, spatholobus stem 15-25 parts, red peony root 15-25 parts, frank incense 15-25 parts, myrrh 15-25 parts, and safflower 5-15 parts.

title: Pharmaceutical composition for cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases and method for preparing the same
abstract: The invention belongs to the medical technical field and discloses a drug combination for the cardiovascular disease and the preparation method of the drug combination. The drug combination contains the pharmacodynamic components of the raw materials of drugs of danshen root, Szechwan lovage rhizome, panax notoginseng, milkvetch root and storax. In order to achieve a better curative effect, a leech, tonka beans and peach nuts can also be added into the drug combination in order to further improve the curative effect, rosewood, axillary choerospondias fruit and earthworms can be added into the drug combination. The drug combination of the invention has the efficacies of promoting the circulation of qi to induce resuscitation, activating blood circulation for removing blood stasis, dredging channels for alleviating pain etc. and is used for preparing the drugs for remedying the cerebral infarction convalescence of the coronary heart disease, the angina pectoris or the arteriosclerosis, the syndrome of which belong to the qi stagnation and blood stasis with the symptoms of chest pain, oppression in the chest, shortness of breath, heart throb, inefficaciousness of limbs, inarticulacy etc. The drug combination of the invention can be made into any preparation type, which is acceptable in the clinic and the pharmacy, and the oral preparation is preferential.

title: Plaster for traumatic injury and bone fracture
abstract: The invention relates to a plaster for treating traumatic injury and fracture, belonging to the pure traditional Chinese medicine preparation. The plaster comprises the following traditional Chinese medicines: musk, crude Sichuan aconite root, crude kusnezoff monkshood, aconitum brachypodum diels, hay, safflower, peach seed, dragon's blood, pangolin, szechuan lovage rhizome, common bletilla pseudobulb, panax pseudoginseng, rhizoma corydalis, clematis root, tortoise plastron, nux vomica, diverse wormwood herb, frankincense, myrrh, rhizoma drynariae, sappan wood, catechus, arisaema saxatile, ground beeltle, manchurian wildginger, amur corktree bark, Chinese forgetmenot root, leech, himalayan teasel root, radix achyranthis bidentatae, garden balsam stem, rhubarb, pyrite, dandelion, corydalis tuber, camphor, borneol, Chinese angelica, scorpion, sesame oil and colophony all the above drugs are crushed, are prepared into paste according to the traditional paste-making method and then are coated on cloth or kraft papers, and the finished product is obtained and when in use, the paste can be baked and then applied at the afflicted part. The paste is mainly applicable to closed new and old fracture, has obvious effect on forming poroma in a short time, and can also treat pain syndromes of traumatic injury, bruise, soft tissue strain, protrusion of lumbar vertebral disc, scapulohumeral periarthritis, arthritis, hyperosteogeny, sciatica and the like. The plaster has the characteristics of extremely fast penetrability, fast acesodyne and detumescence, forming poroma in shorter time, fast relieving the pain caused by nerve compression, convenient use, no toxic side effect and the like, thus reducing the pain of patients, and shortening course of treatment until recovery.

title: Pharmaceutical composition of chinese herbs for treating snuffle, headache and the use thereof
abstract: This invention has published a composition of medicine for awaking brain, relieving pain and growing in intelligence, which is made up with dahurian angelica root 10-30 pare-by-weight, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 0.7-1.5 pare-by-weight, herba asari 0.7-1.5 pare-by-weight, borneolum syntheticum 0.7-1.5 pare-by-weight. The invented medicine has the feature of high absorbing speed, good effect, non-side-effect and easy administration. It can both treat disease and maintain health. Also, it is snuffed by nose, which makes it easily to administration.

title: Herbal tea
abstract: The invention discloses a herbal tea for treating common cold, wind-cold-dampness, cephalalgia, abdomen pain, cough, phlegm and dysentery, wherein the tea comprises orange peel 25g, green tangerine orange peel 25g, bupleurum root 25g, areca-nut 25g, magnolia bark 25g, malt 25g, kudzuvine root 50g, large-leaf gentian root 25g, dahurian angelica root 25g, licorice root 25g, fruit of citron 25g, peppermint 25g, medicated leaven 20g, atractylodes rhizome 20g, pinellia tuber 40g, haw 50g, radish seeds 35g, purple perilla 35g, pubescent angelica root 35g, notopterygium root 35g, cimicifuga rhizome 12. 5g, Chinese ephedra 15g, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 10g, right amount of ginger ale and tea.

title: Yang-freeing and Qi-boosting health-care tea
abstract: The invention discloses Yang-freeing and Qi-boosting health-care tea, which is characterized in that the main ingredients comprise 15 to 30 grams of raw raidx astragali, 5 grams of liquoric root, 15 grams of codonopsis pilosula, 10 grams of cassia twig, 10 grams of ginseng and10 grams of mix-fried liquoric root for treating the heart throb and knotted and intermittent pulse of patients with coronary heart disease, 10 grams of szechuan lovage rhizome, 20 grams of salvia miltiorrhiza bunge, 15 grams of raw keel, 15 grams of raw oyster, 15 grams of magnetitum, 40 grams of huai valleys grown wheat, 20 grams of pericarpium trichosanthis, 10 grams of turmeric root-tuber and 10 grams of orange fibers are added, or 10 grams of szechuan lovage rhizome, 20 grams of salvia miltiorrhiza bunge, 15 grams of raw keel, 15 grams of magnetitum and 40 grams of huai valleys grown wheat are added for treating chest stuffiness and precardial pain, 20 grams of pericarpium trichosanthis, 10 grams of turmeric root-tuber, and 10 grams of orange fibers are added for great pains, szechwan Chinaberry fruit which is raw medicament of Sichuan Chinaberry powder and corydalis yanhusuo W. T. Wang are semi-ground and taken with water for 2 to 3 times each day for treating insomnia and dreaminess, spina date seed and platycladi seeds are added for treating the heart throb of people with rheumatic heart disease, mulberry twig, gentiana macrophylla, turmeric and Chinese taxillus twig are added and for treating the heart throb and chest stuffiness of people with myocarditis, lightyellow sophora root, salvia miltiorrhiza bunge, coastal glehnia root and the like are added. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing the medicaments placing the mixture in a vessel and soaking the mixture in water for 25 minutes decocting the mixture over a slow fire for 15 minutes and obtaining about 200 milliliters of liquid to be taken in a day in two times.

title: Medicinal liquor for treating traumatic injury as well as neck, shoulder and lumbocrural pain
abstract: The invention discloses medicinal liquor for treating traumatic injuries and neck, shoulder, waist and leg pains. The medicinal liquor is prepared from 39 medicinal herbs including Chinese Silkvine Root-bark, Safflower, herba schizonepetae, Herba Selaginellae, Notopterygii Rhizoma, Thickleaf Croton Root, pepper, Angelica sinensis, wallich wedelia herb, semen persicae, cassia twig, cinnamon, Paeonia lactiflora Pall, tree peony bark, Szechwan Lovage Rhizome, frankincense (roasting), myrrh(roasting), Root or leaf of Dockleaf Goldenray, clove, nard, native copper, nakedflower beautyberry branchlet and leaf, sheepear inula herb, vietnamese sophora root, Willianms Elder Twig, psychotria rubra, Yelowhairy Premna, lignum millettiae, complanate clubmoss herb, phyllanthus reticulatus, shinyleaf pricklyash root, ginger, raw curare, raw aconite root, raw kusnezoff monkshood root, menthol, borneol, camphor and sanguis draconis by mixing according to a certain weight ratio and extracting with ethanol. The medicinal liquor has the efficacies of expelling the wind and dissolving stasis, reducing swelling and easing pain, restoring menstrual flow and activating blood circulation, reducing pains and diminishing inflammation, strengthening muscles and bones and the like and can treat strains, traumatic injuries, bruise, contusion, strain injury, injuries of lumbar muscles and damaged neck, shoulder, waist and leg pains and the like.

title: HERBAL PRODUCT CONTAINING GLUCOSAMINE
abstract: Pharmaceutical compositions comprising a low dosage of glucosamine and at least one circulation-enhancing herbal product, such as Suberect Spatholobus Stem (aulis Spatholobi), Motherwort herb (Herba Leonuri), Tumeric Root Tuber (Radix Curcumae), Medicinal Cyathula Root (Radix Cyathulae), Sanchi (Radix Notoginseng), Danshen Root (Radix Salviae Miltorrhizae), Szechwan Lovage Rhizome (Rhizoma Chuanxiong), Yanhusuo (Rhizoma Corydalis), Zedoray Rhizome (Rhizoma Curcumae), Common Burreed Tuber (Rhizoma Sparganni), Peach Seed (Semen Persicae), Safflower (Flos Carthami), Gummi Olibanum, or Myrrha, are described. The aforementioned glucosamine and circulation-enhancing herbal compositions can be used to treat joint pain, arthritis, amenorrhea, dysmenorrhea, and muscle weakness.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating dysmenorrhea and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a new Chinese medicinal composition for treating dysmenorrhea and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition mainly comprises the following raw material medicaments: root of red-rooted salvia, yanhushuo, fenugreek lysimachia, benzoin, rosewood heart wood, storax, safflower, peach seed, divaricate saposhnikovia root, cassia twig, szechuan lovage rhizome, dried orange peel, immature bitter orange, costustoot, rhizome of nutgrass flatsedge, szechwan chinaberry fruit, radix curcumae, combined spicebush root, longstamen onion bulb, aspongopus, honey-fried frankincense, honey-fried myrrh, leonurus heterophyllus, hiraute shiny bugleweed herb, twotooth achyranthes root, cowherb seed, ground beeltle, raw astragalus, radix rehmanniae praeparata, dragon's blood, honey-fried pangolin scales and the like. The Chinese medicinal composition of the invention can be prepared into any common oral administration preparation according to the conventional method of Chinese medicinal preparations. The Chinese medicinal composition can improve symptoms such as dysmenorrheal, menstrual stomachache, tumescence in chest and hypochondrium, scurrying pain in hypogastrium, irritable mood, emotional instability and the like obviously, and has the advantages of definite clinical effect, obvious curative effect and quick response. The Chinese medicinal composition also has the advantages of low cost, no toxic or side effect and the like.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating trigeminal neuralgia and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating trigeminal neuralgia. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is prepared by Szechuan lovage rhizome, tall gastrodia tuber, twotooth achyranthes root, dried rehmannia root, white paeony root, dahurian angelica root, earthworm, largehead atractylodes rhizome, gambir plant, Chinese gentian, simpleleaf shrub chastetree fruit, nutgrass galingale rhizome, red paeony root, manchurian wildginger, sea-ear shell, puncturevine caltrop fruit, liquoric root, divaricate saposhnikovia root and/or a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. The invention further relates to a preparation method of the traditional Chinese medicine composition. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has the efficacies of promoting blood circulation, removing blood stasis, dispelling pathogenic wind, relieving pain, nourishing yin, suppressing hyperactive yang, lowering fire and calming wind and is used for treating the trigeminal neuralgia and the like caused by pathogenic wind attacking the superficies and liver fire flaming.

title: Medicament composition for treating female acyesis and aphoria, and uses thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for treating female infertility, the composition comprises the following components by parts by weight: 10-15 parts of Chinese angelica, 9-10 parts of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 10-15 parts of nutgrass galingale rhizome, 6-10 parts of himalayan teasel root, 10-15 parts of baical skullcap root, 10-15 parts of argy wormwood leaf, 10-15 parts of cassia twig, 6-10 parts of Chinese taxillus twig, 10-15 parts of suberect spatholobus stem, 10-15 parts of largehead atractylodes rhizome and 10-15 parts of figwort root. The composition has simple components, simple production, low cost, exact efficacy and no side effects. The composition has the effects of nourishing yin, nourishing blood, warming channel for dispelling cold, activating qi, regulating menstruation and relieving pain. Therefore, the composition achieves the purposes of promoting the blood circulation, leading genital organs to be in the relax state, facilitating the drug absorption and leading sperm to pass smoothly and further realizing the conception.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating antiaditis and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a novel Chinese medicinal composition for treating antiaditis and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition mainly comprises the following raw material medicaments: blackberrykiky rhizome, immature bitter orange, Chinese eaglewood, szechuan lovage rhizome, tangerine peel, costustoot, radish seed, szechwan chinaberry fruit, longstamen onion bulb, honey suckle flower, philippine violet herb, mongolian dandelion herb, weeping forsythiae capsule, figwort root, fresh rehmannia, lightyellow sophora root, baical skullcap root, chrysanthemum, bupleurum, kudzuvine root, mint, great burdock achene, gypsum, anemarrhena asphodeloides bunge, common lophatherum herb, mongolian snakegourd root, gentian, heartleaf houttuynia herb, dahurian patrinia herb and the like. The Chinese medicinal composition can be prepared into any one common orally-taken preparation by a conventional Chinese medicinal preparation method. The Chinese medicinal composition can remarkably improve the symptoms: antiaditis, antiadoncus, inflamed and purulent pharynx, ardor and pain, bitter mouth and dry pharynx, dry congh, cough and the like, and has extract clinical treatment effect, remarkable treatment effect and quick response. The Chinese medicinal composition also has the advantages of low cost, basically no toxic or side effect and the like.

title: Method for preparing compound cavel capsule
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a compound cavel capsule, which comprises the following steps: the whole cavel is cleaned and is steamed and boiled for sixteen hours by a globe digester, the decoction is performed for three times and the mixture is filtered to obtain the decoction liquid, filtrate is concentrated into thick paste szechuan lovage rhizome, angelica dahurica, processed radix aconiti are ground into coarse powder, 70 percent ethanol is taken as a solvent, and the dynamic reverse current extraction is performed the extracting solution is added into the cavel paste, is stirred, is kept stand and is filtered, the filtrate is concentrated into hot stream extract, proper amount of starch is added into the hot stream extract be stirred, the mixture is dried and ground into fine powder and is filled into a capsule therefore, the product is obtained. The preparation method ensures that the effective components of the medicine are extracted completely the cavel does not use pang slice, thereby greatly improving the efficiency in addition, the method is convenient to realize the mass production under the continuous GMP condition. The medicine has the functions of soothing liver and relieving pain and is used for treating migraine, vascular headache, tension headache and neuralgia.

title: Blood-stasis-dissipating blood-circulation-promoting fast fracture-setting medicament
abstract: The present invention provides a rapid coaptation medicine 'jiegurushendan' with promoting blood circulation function by removing blood stasis which belongs to plarmacy technology field. The jiegurushendan is a hereditary secret formula of meng's coaptation. The medicine is prepared from Chinese traditional medicines including 15-8 parts dragon's blood, 4-8 parts szechuan lovage rhizome, 4-8 parts olibanum, 4-8 parts myrrh, 4-8 parts angelica, 2-5 parts ephedra, 4-8 parts tuchong, 1-5 parts white paeony root, 15-8 parts sanchi, 4-8 parts fired pyrite, 6-10 parts danshen root, 15-8 parts deer's horn, 1-3 parts vermilion, 1-3 parts borneol, 4-8 parts liquorice, 1-3 parts saffron, 0.1-0.2 parts muskiness. The preparing technology is: weighing as formulation, then pulverizating into fine powder. The medicine treats mainly in: all fractures, injuries from falls, trauma edema pain, blood stasis condensation, injury of tendon and muscle. The medicine has merits of low amount medicine, low cost and obvious effect, and has advantages of positive curing effect, simply processing, non-toxic side effect, rapid stop-pain and coaptation.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine formulation for treating gastrosis and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a Chinese patent medicine for treating gastric diseases. The Chinese patent medicine is characterized in that the medical prescription comprises prepared milkvetch root, cassia twig, medcinal evodia fruit, cassia bark, cuttlebone, peach seed, safflower, Chinese angelica, Szechuan lovage rhizome, red paeony root, salvia miltiorrhiza root, tree peony bark, rhizoma corydalis, wenyujin concise rhizome, common burreed rhizome, zedoary, leech, costustoot, bitter orange, combined spicebush root, golden thread, prepared liquoric root and rehmannia root. Compared with the prior Chinese patent medicines for treating the gastric diseases, the Chinese patent medicine of the invention has more reasonable formula, the synergy among various medicine components can promote the blood circulation of gastrointestinal mucosa, can rapidly recover the inflammation parts and the gastric ulcer surfaces thereof and can achieve the treatment effect on activating blood circulation, activating qi-flowing, relieving pain, nourishing qi, strengthening spleen and regulating spleen and stomach, the efficacy is remarkable and the Chinese patent medicine has no toxicity or side effects the formula has the efficiency on swallowing acid, warming stomach, benefiting qi for warming stomach, dispelling cold, activating qi, activating blood circulation and relieving pain. The Chinese patent medicine is mainly used for gastric ulcer and duodenal ulcer caused by deficient cold of spleen and stomach, cold coagulation and blood stasis, as well as chronic atrophic gastritis.

title: Chinese medicinal composition having effect of promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of Chinese medicinal preparations, in particular to the field of Chinese medicinal patches. A Chinese medicinal composition having the effect of promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis comprises the following Chinese medicinal components: radix astragali, szechwon tangshen root, dwarf lilyturf tuber, szechuan lovage rhizome, radix angelicae sinensis, cassia twig, Indian buead, scorpion, costustoot, tall gastrodia tuber, safflower, prepared liquorice root, red data and ginger slice of which the weight ratio is 20-40:20-40:10-30:5-15:10-30:10-20:10-20:1-10:5-15:10-20:10-20:5-15:1-10:1-5. The Chinese medicinal composition has effects of restoring menstrual flow and invigorating blood circulation, relieving pain with aromatics and reinforcing functional activities of the heart, and is suitable for treating symptoms such as coronary heart diseases, cardiopalmus, panasthenia and the like, and has the advantages of safety and obvious comprehensive effect.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating coronary heart disease and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a Chinese medicinal composition for treating coronary heart disease, which is prepared from radix glycyrrhizae preparata, fragrant solomonseal rhizome, white paeony root, cortex acanthopanacis, dwarf lilyturf tuber, red sage root, immature bitter orange, tuckahoe, dried ginger, endothelium corneum gigeriae galli, cassia twig, dried rehmannia root, radix bupleuri, donkey-hide glue, stephania tetrandra, szechuan lovage rhizome, adenophora stricta, motherwort herb, Chinese angelica, radix astragali preparata, and/or a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. The invention also relates to a preparation method for the Chinese medicinal composition. The Chinese medicinal composition has the efficacies of removing dampness by diuresis and eliminating phlegm, promoting blood circulation by removing blood stasis, tonifying middle-Jiao and Qi, and invigorating Yang and open vessels, and can be used for treating thoracic pain, chest tightness and heart palpitations, cold sweat and other symptoms which are caused by the coronary heart disease resulting from Yang deficiency, Yin-cold of evil invasion.

title: Toutongling
abstract: Toukangling pertains to an oral preparation and is mainly used for treating headache and migraine. The main ingredients are composed of Chinese angelica, Szechuan lovage rhizome, incised notopterygium rhizome, doubleteeth pubescent angilica root, simpleleaf shrub chastetree fruit, Chinese thorowax root, swordlike atractylodes rhizome, dwarf lilyturf tuber, baical skullcap root, chrysanthemum, divaricate saposhnikovia root, dahurian angelica root, manchurian wildginger, Chinese ligusticum rhizome, liquoric root and fresh ginger. The Toukangling has the effects of activating blood circulation, dredging channels, dispelling pathogenic wind and relieving pain. The drug can be made into a decoction, 500 to 600ml water is added for soaking the drug for 1 hour, the boiling is firstly carried out by using strong fire, then the decoction is carried out for 15 to 20 minutes by using small fire for the preparation, the dosage is once per day and one half in the morning and the night. The drug can also be made into pills, powder, granules, capsules or oral liquor, 3 to 12g for each time, and three times per day.

title: Medicine for treating acute and chronic rhinitis and sinusitis
abstract: The invention discloses a medicine for treating acute and chronic rhinitis and sinusitis which comprises the raw materials based on the parts by weight: 2-6 parts of beautiful sweetgum fruit, 2-6 parts of white gourd kernels, 2-6 parts of pericarpium trichosanthis, 2-5 parts of hawksbill carapace, 3-8 parts of herba lycopi, 1-5 parts of cordate houttuynia, 2-6 parts chastetree fruit, 0.3-0.8 partof fructus gleditsiae, 1-4 parts of centipeda minima, 0.5-1.5 parts of asarum heterotropoides, 3-8 parts of fried fructus xanthii, 3-9 parts of biond magnolia flower, 2-6 parts of angelica anomala, 3-8 parts of north ligusticum, 2-6 parts of scutellaria baicalensis, 2-6 parts of flos chrysanthemi indici, 3-8 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome and 1-5 parts of liquorice. The medicine selects the rawmaterials with unique and reasonable mixture ratio, and has the effects of dispelling wind and heat, clearing away heat and toxic material, promoting diuresis, nourishing lung and promoting the restoration consciousness as well as relieving pain of brain and eyes, thus effectively treating symptoms such as rhinobyon, yellow thick nasal mucus, headache, dizziness, hypomnesis and the like caused bythe acute and chronic rhinitis and sinusitis.

Liquid medicine obtained from the two steps is mixed together and cooled. The medicine is taken half an hour before breakfast and two hours after supper respectively.By taking the medicine for half a month, the medicine can clear heat and toxic material, promote digestion, remove food retention and flatulence, alleviate pain, harmonize intestine-stomach, elevate the spleen yang, eliminate dampness and tonify spleen for nourishing qi. By taking the medicine for a month, gastrointestinal disfunction is improved, regeneration and repair of intestinal mucosa is promoted and overall immunity is enhanced, which achieves the goal of complete cure. The invention treat 120 cases all together with a efficient rate of 100 percent and a recovery rate of 99 percent.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating femoral head necrosis and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating osteonecrosis of the femoral head and a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is a medicament which is prepared by ginseng, membranous milkvetch root, Szechuan lovage rhizome, red paeony root, divaricate saposhnikovia root, suberect spatholobus stem, medicinal cyathula root, radix rehmanniae preparata, peach seed, safflower, sanchi, barbary wolfberry fruit, Chinese angelica, prepared common monkshood daughter root, deer horn gelatin, ephedra herb, stir-fried white mustard seed, epimedium herb, prepared common monkshood mother root, prepared kusnezoff monkshood root, scorpion, centipede, prepared frankincense, prepared myrrh, Szechwan Chinaberry fruit, ground beetle, native copper, dragon's blood and other medicines by the conventional pharmaceutical process. The invention has the advantages that the traditional Chinese medicine composition has special formula, exact efficacy, safety, economy, no obvious toxicity or side effects and effects of activating blood circulation, removing blood stasis, tonifying liver and kidney, strengthening spleen, benefiting qi, strengthening tendon and bone, dispelling pathogenic wind and dampness, dredging channels and relieving pain, thereby being applicable to patients with the osteonecrosis of the femoral head for administration.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine external-washing medicinal granules for treating postoperative complication of piles
abstract: The invention relates to traditional Chinese medicine external-washing medicinal granules for treating the postoperative complication of piles, comprising the following raw materials according to parts by weight and the mixture ratio: 10 parts of physalis grass, 10 parts of purslane, 6 parts of sophora flavescens, 6 parts of rhubarb, 6 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome, 6 parts of angelica, 6 parts of white peony root, 5 parts of motherwort, 2 parts of borneol, 5 parts of sodium sulphate and 5 parts of sophora japonica. In the invention, various raw material medicinal materials are traditional Chinese medicine compound particles purchased in the market and are taken and mixed according to the mixture ratio so as to obtain the traditional Chinese medicine external-washing medicinal granules. The invention has the use method that the traditional Chinese medicine external-washing medicinal granules of 60g to 65g are taken and dissolved in boiled water of 1000ml to 1500ml, and fuming and sitting bath are sequentially carried out for 20 minutes. Sitting bath is carried out for one time every day or after defecation, one treatment course is for 7 days, and all other medicines are stopped taking in the treating period. The invention has the advantages of enhancing the cure rate of the operation of the piles, preventing and treating the postoperative complication and effectively relieving the postoperative pain and reducing the treating time of a patient. The invention has perfect matching, simple and convenient use method, reliable curative effect and no toxic or side effect.

title: Oral medication for treating epigastric pain
abstract: The invention provides an oral medicine for remedying stomachache typed diseases. The medicine is made from the raw materials with the following portions of 5-12 portions of magnolia officinalis, 4-6 portions of tangerine peel, 4-6 portions of immature tangerine, 4-6 portions of cyperus rotundus l, 4-6 portions of citrus aurantium, 4-6 portions of Szechwan lovage rhizome, 4-6 portions of rhizoma corydalis, 4-6 portions of turmeric, 1-8 portions of cortex moutan, 4-6 portions of white peony root, 4-6 portions of amomum, 1-7 portions of angelica, 4-9 portions of evodia rutaecarpa, 1-8 portions of cardamom, 1-7 portions of clove, 1-7 portions of eaglewood, 1-7 portions of cinnamon, 4-6 portions of , 1-7 portions of rosa banksiae, 1-7 portions of poria cocos, 4-6 portions of sodium bicarbonate and 4-6 portions of prepared licorice. The clinic of the oral medicine is mainly used for remedying acute or chronic gastritis, gastric ulcer, chronic atrophic gastritis, dyspepsia, chronic hepatitis b and so on. The total effective rate for remedying chronic gastritis is 94.7 percent. The total effective rate for remedying gastric ulcer and chronic atrophic gastritis is 93.9 percent. The total effective rate for remedying dyspepsia is 96.1 percent, and at the same time, the oral medicine also has efficacy for remedying chronic hepatitis B.

title: Method for preparing tiger-bone wine
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a tiger-bone wine, which comprises the following steps: soaking 250g of tiger bones, 250g of fish poison yam, 250g of epimedium, 250g of adlay, 250g of achyranthes root, 250g of rehmannia glutinosa, 250g of tangerine peel, 250g of green leaves of mulberry, 16g of Chinese angelica, 16g of incised notopterygium rhizome, 16g of combined spicebush root, 16g of acanthopanax bark, 16g of Chinese atractylodes rhizome, 16g of divaricate saposhnikovia root, 16g of green tangerine peel, 16g of moutan, 16g of pubescent angelica root, 16g of szechuan lovage rhizome, 16g of dahurian angelica root, 16g of white paeony root, 16g of chaenomeles lagenaria, 16g of redroot gromwell root, 16g of medlar, 16g of safflower, 16g of malaytea scurfpea fruit, 16g of common monkshood mother root, 16g of kusnezoff monkshood root, 16g of quilled cinnamon bark flour, 16g of costustoot flour, 16g of clove flour, 16g of sandalwood flour, 16g of purple cardamom flour, 16g of finger citron flour, 16g of villous amomum fruit flour, 16g of long-nosed pit viper, 16g of ginseng flour, 16g of hairy antler flour, 2,156g of brown sugar, 625g of red yeast rice, 5,000g of honey, 63g of frankincense flour, 63g of myrrh flour, 125g of pine nodular branch, 0.6g of musk, 156g of raw eucommia bark and 156g of himalayan teasel root into 28kg of white wine, filling the mixture in a bottle, sealing the bottle and obtaining the tiger-bone wine. The tiger-bone wine of the invention mainly treats itch and pain of bones and muscles, inconvenient waist knee and numb body, and can be used for treating rheumatoid arthritis.

title: Antalgic medicine liquor
abstract: A medical wine for treating pain. It comprises sichuan aconite root 8í 1/2 20g,wild aconkite root 8í 1/2 20g, shichuan Chinese flowering quince 8í 1/2 20g, honey suckle 8í 1/2 20g, rhizome of Sichuan lovage 8í 1/2 20g, angelica 8í 1/2 20g,ledebouriella root 8í 1/2 20g, dark plum 8í 1/2 20g, 2í 1/2 5 centipedes, eucommia10í 1/2 20g, atractylodes ovata 10í 1/2 20g, 1í 1/2 3long-noded pit vipers, white sugar 100í 1/2 200g, white wine 38íÒí 1/2 60íÒ.
