title: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treatment of cervical spondylopathy and osteoarticular diseases and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for the treatment of cervical spondylopathy and osteoarticular diseases and a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition mainly consists of the following bulk drugs: cassia twig, Chinese angelica root, ledebouriella root, rhizome of Sichuan lovage, notopterygium, peppermint, root of kudzuvine, chrysanthemum flower, Chinese ephedra, capsule of weeping forsythia, dandelion, radix angelicae pubescentis, cortex moutan, lindera root, nutagrass flatsedge rhizome, auckandia root, red peony root, white peony root, root bark of barbary wolf berry, red sage root, tetrandra root, acanthopanax bark, bark of eucommia, achyranthis bidentatae, indian bread, magnolia bark, atractylodes rhizome, alisma rhizome, plantain seed, medicated leaven, atractylodes macrocephala, bark of chinese cassia tree, dried ginger, pricklyash berry, clove, curcuma root, corydalis tuber, safflower, peach kernel, motherwort, bighead atractylodes rhizome, raw milkvetch root, asiabell, glehnia root and boxthorn. The traditional Chinese medicine composition can obviously improve cervical spondylopathy and symptoms such as spondylopathy contraction, shoulder irritation, arthralgia, muscular tension, muscular fatigue, muscular acid bilge, dizziness, cephalalgia, soreness of the waist and the knees and pain in the legs and numbness of the extremities of other osteoarticular disease patients. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has stable efficacy, and moreover has advantages of quick effect, sustained effect, applicability to long-term use, low cost, no toxic-side effects and the like.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating disease that postpartum lochia can't go and preparation method and quality control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a drug combination for treating lochia after post partum, a preparation method and a quality control method thereof. The drug combination of the invention comprises the following raw materials: angelica, Szechwan Lovage Rhizome, semen persicae, dried ginger, dry carbon, leonurus and dipsacus root. The preparation method is that the raw materials are grinded into course powder 8-12 times amount of water is added for extracting volatile oil for 5-8 hours water solution after the distillation is collected by another vessel dregs of a decoction is boiled for 2-3 times after being added with water, wherein, 6-8 times amount of water is added to be boiled for 1-2h for every time the boiled liquids are mixed and filtered the filtered liquid is mixed with the solution to be concentrated into thick paste which is added with brown sugar in optimal dose to be mixed uniformly and prepared into particles the particles are dried at 50-70 DEG C, are grinded and prepared into particles with ethanol the volatile oil is sprayed and then the drug combination is obtained. High performance liquid chromatography is adopted by the invention for the content determination of ferulic acid. The drug combination of the invention is provided with good efficacy in treating lochia after post partum and abdomen pain.

title: Medicament for treating beriberi
abstract: The invention relates to a drug for treating beri-beri which is characterized in that the drug is prepared by the following raw materials by parts by weight: 5-7 parts of pangolin scales, 5-7 parts of tremella fuciformis dried product, 6-8 parts of bletilla striata, 7-8 parts of golden thread, 15-20 parts of borneol, 10-12 parts of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 3-5 parts of plant ash, 2-5 parts of cicada slough, 4-6 parts of holly leaf fresh product, 2-4 parts of natural indigo, 3-5 parts of siberian cocklebur herb dried product, 8-10 parts of manchurian wildginger, 6-9 parts of densefruit pittany root-bark, 10-12 parts of lightyellow sophora root, 8-10 parts of fennel fruit, 5-7 parts of yanhusuo, 3-5 parts of myrrh, 6-8 parts of Chinese angelica, 5-7 parts of trogopterus dung, 10-12 parts of white vinegar, 5-10 parts of garlic and 15-20 parts of common salt. The drug has the advantages that the drug can rapidly relieve the itch and the pain, rapidly heal the wound and be effective by 1-2 times, patients with the moderate beri-beri can be healed in 6 days, the patients with the severe beri-beri can be healed in 30 days, and the drug has no side effects, good efficacy, rapid onset of action, ability of radically curing the beri-beri, difficult recurrence, no complications or sequelae and low cost.

title: Chinese medicine bone fracture plaster and method of preparing the same
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese drug bone injury plaster and a preparing method thereof. The plaster is composed of the components calculated according to the proportion by weight as follows: 10 to 20 parts of Chinese angelica root, 10 to 20 parts of acanthopanax bark, 10 to 20 parts of zedoary turmeric, 10 to 20 parts of earth worm, 10 to 20 parts of ground beetle, 10 to 20 parts of bark of eucommia, 10 to 20 parts of achyranthes root, 10 to 20 parts of root of herbaceous peony, 10 to 20 parts of pangolin scales, 10 to 20 parts of alisma rhizome, 10 to 20 parts rhizome of Sichuan lovage, 10 to 20 parts of Chinese flowering quince, 10 to 20 parts of Chinese clematis and 10 to 20 parts of angelica root. The Chinese drug bone injury plaster of the invention ensures drugs to permeate the focus of body partial organ and hemopoietic tissue through skin, the pharmacodynamics effect is generated, the efficiencies of promoting blood circulation to dispel blood stasis, reducing swelling to ease pain, relaxing myospasm and regulating qi, dispelling coldness and pathogenic wind, and promoting reunion of the fractured bones are achieved, therefore the plaster has good curative effects on the closed fracture and crack and the diseases of the pains in neck, shoulder, waist, leg, etc. The plaster has the advantages that the usage is convenient, the raw material sources are wide, the preparation method is simple, and the cost is low.

title: Chinese medicine compound for oral administration for treating vasculitis
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese herbal medicine compound for treating vasculitis, pertaining to the field of Chinese herbal medicine, which is made from following raw materials according to certain weight ratios: 20 to 30 grams of Chinese angelica, 10 to 20 grams of spatholobus stem, 15 to 25 grams of danshen root, 5 to 15 grams of frankincense, 3 to 8 grams of asarum, 15 to 25 grams of szechwan lovage rhizome, 5 to 15 grams of radix cyathulae, 3 to 8 grams of safflower, 10 to 20 grams of rehmanniae praeparatum and 20 to 30 grams of radix astragali. The above raw materials are immersed into water for 2 hours and decocted with water for 30 minutes and then the medicine liquid is poured out proper water is poured into the pan and decocted for 30 minutes and then the medicine liquid is poured out the two parts of medicine liquid are mixed together and distilled to remove water with mild fire. The medicine is taken after meals. Each dose of the decoction is taken in a day. Each dose is divided into two parts for twice oral taking in a day. The medicine is taken continuously for 30 days as one course. With extensive sources of raw materials, easy obtaining, low price and no toxic nor side effect, the invention can take effect of blood enriching and mixing, urination promoting and detumescence, pathogenic heat removing from blood and dredging meridian, relieving pain.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating tonsillitis
abstract: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for curing tonsillitis, which is characterized in that the composition comprises the following components by the weight part: 9 to 11 parts of thinleaf milkwort root, 8 to 10 parts of flos carthami, 4 to 8 parts of Chinese magnoliavine fruit, 8 to 12 parts of eucalypti leaves, 5 to 10 parts of semen cassiae torae, 9 to 12 parts of pomegranate bark, 5 to 10 parts of szechwan lovage rhizome, 8 to 12 parts of danshen root, 12 to 15 parts of muskiness, 13 to 15 parts of balloonflower root, 9 to 11 parts of common coltsfoot flower, 5 to 7 parts of armeniacae semen, 12 to 14 parts of licorice root, 13 to 15 parts of fructus perillae, 8 to 11 parts of flos lonicerae, 8 to 11 parts of forsythia suspense, 4 to 8 parts of baical skullcap root, 5 to 9 parts of dried tangerine peel and 9 to 11 parts of dried ginger. The composition has the advantages of good curative effect, instant effect, convenient administration, no complaint, recurrence prevention, no toxic and side effect, no injection, no operation and relieved pain in the treatment as well as instant effect and low cost the composition ensures that the patient can fully recover from the invasion within 1 to 3 days and non-invasion within 2 days and the composition prevents the recurrence after the patient is cured, particularly more than one year for common patients, and the composition allows some patients to eradicate tonsillitis at one time without recurrence.

title: Chinese medicinal preparation for treating chronic nasosinusitis and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a Chinese medicinal preparation for treating chronic nasosinusitis and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine. The Chinese medicinal preparation comprises the following Chinese medicinal herbs in part by weight: 8 to 20 parts of small centipeda herb, 10 to 30 parts of mentha haplocalyx, 15 to 30 parts of stir-fried siberian cocklour fruit, 12 to 30 parts of angelica dahurlica, 15 to 40 parts of thunberg fritillary bulb, 10 to 30 parts of platycodon root, 10 to 30 parts of baical skullcap root, 15 to 40 parts of yunnan manyleaf paris rhizome, 15 to 40 parts of stir-fried stiff silkworm, 10 to 30 parts of centipede, 12 to 35 parts of calcined yellow croaker ear-stone, 20 to 50 parts of astragalus, 15 to 45 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome and 6 to 20 parts of raw liquorice root. The preparation method comprises the following steps of: a) drying the Chinese medicinal herbs in the weight part ratio at the temperature of between 60 and 80 DEG C and b) after pulverizing the dried Chinese medicinal herbs into 100 to 200-meshed fine powder and mixing the powder components in the ratio, performing thermalization and sterilization at the temperature of between 100 and 110 DEG C for 10 to 30 minutes to prepare powder raw materials, and preparing powder into capsules or honeyed pills. The Chinese medicinal preparation has the advantages of clear formula, simple method, easy operation and application and low cost, has the effects of dispelling wind and clearing heat, promoting the restoration of consciousness and stopping pain, evacuating pus and removing sinus, improving immunity, eliminating the pathogenic factor and strengthening the body resistance and addressing both the symptoms and root causes, recuperates patients who suffer from the chronic nasosinusitis fundamentally, and has reliable curative effect and low relapse rate.

title: Chinese medicinal bath
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicinal bath and belongs to the field of Chinese herb medicaments for bath. The Chinese medicinal bath is characterized by comprising the following components: 30 to 35 grams of peach seed, 20 to 25 grams of safflower, 30 to 35 grams of nutgrass galingale rhizome, 20 to 25 grams of immature bitter orange, 20 to 25 grams of fried squirrel's droppings, 20 to 25 grams of common burreed rhizome, 20 to 25 grams of combined spicebush root, 10 to 15 grams of dragon's blood, 10 to 15 grams of fried earthworm, 30 to 35 grams of Chinese angelica, 10 to 15 grams of szechuan lovage rhizome, 10 to 15 grams of scorpion, 300 to 350 grams of raidx astragali, 100 to 200 grams of mirabilite, 30 to 35 grams of peach blossom, 50 to 60 grams of dahurian angelica root, 20 to 25 grams of large head atractylodes rhizome, 10 to 15 grams of Sichuan coptis root, 40 to 45 grams of baical skullcap root, 360 to 400 grams of salvia miltiorrhiza bunge, 20 to 25 grams of liquoric root and 10 to 15 grams of nux vomica. The components are decocted in water for later use. The Chinese medicinal bath solves the problem of difficult and troublesome Chinese medicament taking for people by treating internal diseases with an external therapy, is simple in use and has the effects of activating blood and dissolving stasis, clearing and activating the channels and collaterals, clearing damp and relieving pain, supplementing blood and qi and perfuming body and beautifying the features.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine for treating chronic paranasal sinusitis
abstract: A Chinese traditional medicine for curing chronic paranasal sinusitis belongs to the Chinese traditional medicine for curing paranasal sinusitis. The ingredients of the medicine (with weights) are siberian cocklebur fruit 15g, biond magnolia flower 9g, mint 6g, angelica 15g, notopterygium root 10g, chuanxiong rhizome 10g, asarum 3g, honeysuckle 15g, chrysanthemum 15g, heartleaf houttuynia herb 30g and glabrous greenbrier rhizome 30g the auxiliary ingredients include shrub chastetree fruit 15g under the situation of serious headache chinese lovage 15g under the situation of headache on the head top bupleur 10g under the situation of painful temple root of lobed kudzuvine 20g under the situation of pain on the top ageratum 10g, scutellaria root 10g and coptis root 6g under the situation of anorexia and greasy fur grassleaf sweetflag rhizome 10g and snakegourd fruit 15g under the situation of much tears and sputum. The composition of the medicine is simple and medicines used in the prescription are all natural herbs the fetching and use of the materials are convenient and the manufacture method is simple the effect is excellent and the price is low in this way, the herbal medicine is especially fit for people living in remote villages far away from counties and towns the curing expense for patients with the disease of chronic paranasal sinusitis is low which solves the problem that the household income is low and the life is poor and the medical conditions is deficient locally.

title: Chinese patent drug for treating and nursing scar
abstract: The present invention relates to a Chinese traditional patent medicine for the treatment and care of the scars - Shine skin scar care lotion, the invention aims at providing a pure tradition Chinese medicine compound preparation which has scientific formula, proper compatibility and can promote the blood circulation, remove the blood stasis, soften and resolve the hard mass, dispel the wind, arrest the itch, relieve the swelling, alleviate the pain and effectively treat a variety of scars caused by various reasons to the patients with scars, particularly to the patients with the large area scar and facial scar which severely affects the aesthetic feeling, furthermore, the invention has significant efficacy for the scars, no toxicity or side effects, low cost, simple process and easy usage. The implementation proposal used by the Shine skin scar care lotion to achieve and ensure the realization of the therapeutic purpose is that: the invention is organically composed of ten typical traditional Chinese medicine of vinegar, honey, panax quinquefolium. L, szechuan lovage rhizome, saposhnikovia divaricata, safflower, fourstamen stephania root, sanchi, drynaria rhizome, cortex acanthopanacis and so on, the drugs are weighed and placed into the vinegar for soaking for 72 hours, and then the drugs are boiled by slow fire for 3 to 5 hours. The invention is finally prepared by filtering, slag cleaning and bottling.

title: Chinese medicinal composition for treating medial headache and migraine and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a new Chinese medicinal composition for treating medial headache and migraine and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition comprises the following raw material medicaments: szechuan lovage rhizome, root of red-rooted salvia, costustoot, fenugreek lysimachia, benzoin, tangerine peel, radix curcumae, cyperus rotunus, golden thread, baical skullcap root, cassia twig, incised notopterygium rhizome, angelica dahurlica, kudzuvine root, peach seed, safflower, common burreed rhizome, zedoary, pangolin scales, raw astragalus, radix paeoniae alba, red paeony root, tall gastrodia tuber, gambir plant, storax, grassleaf sweelflag rhizome, fineleaf schizonepeta herb, divaricate saposhnikovia root, radix ephedrae, weeping forsythia, manchurian wildginger, biond magnolia flower, mentha haplocalyx, raw rehmannia root, szechwan chinaberry fruit, rose, radix pseudo-ginseng, rosewood heart wood, garden burnet root, leonurus heterophyllus, cowherb seed, ground beeltle, sappan wood, dragon's blood, pinellia tuber and the like. The Chinese medicinal composition can be prepared into any oral administration preparation used commonly according to the conventional method of Chinese medicinal preparations. The Chinese medicinal composition can improve headaches of bitamporal, foreheads and orbital parts, pulsatile headache or boring pain and the like, and associated symptoms of nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, frequent micturition, urination disorder, stuffy nose, palpitation, hypertension, hypotension, arrhythmia, megrim, ataxia, diplopia, hearing loss, tinnitus, disturbance of consciousness and the like obviously, and has definite clinical effects, obvious curative effect and quick response. The Chinese medicinal composition of the invention is combined by adopting medicinal and edible medicaments formulated by National Formulary basically, and thus, the Chinese medicinal composition has the advantages of low cost and no toxic or side effect.

title: Toxin-elimination health-care medicine composition
abstract: The invention discloses a toxin-discharging life-nourishing drug combination, prepared of the follow raw materials in weight proportion: Rhubarb 30í 1/2 120ú Szechwan Lovage Rhizome 30í 1/2 90ú Chinese Mosla Herb 30í 1/2 90ú Flos Caryophyllata 30í 1/2 60ú Olibanum 30í 1/2 60ú Sandalwood 30í 1/2 60ú Nardostachyos Root 30í 1/2 60ú Turmeric Root-tuber 60í 1/2 120ú Radix Puerariae 90í 1/2 150ú Dahurian Angelica Root 30í 1/2 90ú Liquorice Root 30í 1/2 60ú Fleeceflower Root 90í 1/2 300ú Medicinal Indianmulberry Root 30í 1/2 60. And when prepared into solution to soak feet, it has functions of defaecating, discharging toxin and nourishing face, relieving fatigue, and removing blood stasis, detumescence and stopping pain, sedation, as well as prohibiting bacteria and fungi, and it can effectively relieve fatigue of the people after tense labor, operation, military training, and long-term bending over the desk, relax the muscles and stimulate the blood circulation, strengthen metabolism if applied long time, and can avoid bad reaction by external washing and soaking feet.

title: Method for treating headache due to yin deficiency by soaking feet in Chinese medicament solution
abstract: The invention relates to a method for treating headache due to yin deficiency by soaking feet in Chinese medicament solution. The method adopts 20 g of pro formula pinellia, 60 g of wild chrysanthemum, 100 g of rhizoma gastrodiae, 30 g of largetrifoliolious bugbane rhizome, 30 g of selfheal, 50 g of notopterygium root, 20 g of asarum, 10 g of figwort, 20 g of vitex trifolia seed, 20 g of radix codonopsis pilosulae, 20 g of angelica, 20 g of szechuan lovage rhizome, and 100 g of mulberry branch, and comprises the following steps: taking the 13 Chinese herbal medicaments according to the proportion and combining all herbal medicaments together pouring the herbal medicaments in an iron pan and adding 5,000 ml warm water to soak the herbal medicaments for 30 minutes boiling the soaked herbal medicaments by mild fire removing the dregs and taking the decoction when the decoction in the boiling pan is left about 3,500 ml pouring the decoction in a wood basin to fumigate both feet firstly when the temperature dropping to 45 DEG C or being comfortable, dipping both feet in the decoction for 50 to 60 minutes each time after foot soaking, wiping water off by a foot towel and alternately pressing or kneading each of the plantar center Yongquan point, plantar adrenal gland point, plantar solar plexus point, plantar liver point, plantar Taixi point and plantar Gongsun point for 100 times and pushing each point for 20 times by moderate force and speed which are advisable to ensure that a patient feels slight ache and pain.

title: Method for treating headache due to yin deficiency by soaking feet in Chinese medicament solution
abstract: The invention relates to a method for treating headache due to yin deficiency by soaking feet in Chinese medicament solution. The method adopts 100 g of rhizoma gastrodiae, 30 g of radix codonopsis pilosulae, 200 g of Chinese wolfberry, 30 g of angelica, 30 g of chrysanthemum, 30 g of szechuan lovage rhizome, 30 g of uncaria stem, 50 g of winter mulberry leaf, 50 g of notopterygium root, 30 g of dahuriae angelica root, 20 g of pubescent angelica root, 15 g of earthworm and 15 g of tuber pinellia, and comprises the following steps: taking the 13 Chinese herbal medicaments according to the proportion and combining all herbal medicaments together pouring the herbal medicaments in an iron pan and adding 5,000 ml warm water to soak the herbal medicaments for 30 minutes boiling the soaked herbal medicaments by mild fire removing the dregs and taking the decoction when the decoction in the boiling pan is left 3,500 ml pouring the decoction in a wood basin to fumigate both feet firstly when the temperature dropping to 45 DEG C or being comfortable, dipping both feet in the decoction for 50 to 60 minutes each time after foot soaking, wiping water off by a foot towel and alternately pressing or kneading each of the plantar center Yongquan point, plantar adrenal gland point, plantar solar plexus point, plantar liver point, plantar Taixi point and plantar Gongsun point 100 times and pushing each point 20 times by moderate force and speed which are advisable to ensure that a patient feels slight ache and pain.

title: Medicament and feet pad for treating calcaneodynia
abstract: The invention relates to a drug and a medical device for remedying the calcaneodynia. The drug for remedying the calcaneodynia consists of the following components (which are calculated according to the weight unit) of 4 to 6 portion of Chinese clematis, 2 to 3 portion of Szechwan lovage rhizome and 2 to 3 portion of borneol. An insole for remedying the calcaneodynia is provided with an insole cover and traditional Chinese medical mats. The insole cover is provided with a bottom part and lateral wing parts, which are placed above the bottom part, and the bottom part and the lateral wing parts are all provided with interlayers, which are mutually communicated. The traditional Chinese medical mats are placed inside the interlayer of the bottom part and the interlayers of the lateral wing parts. The invention adopts the totally novel method to remedy the calcaneocynia, which mainly consists of two parts of a part of traditional Chinese medicine, which can take effect of activating blood circulation and dredging channels for alleviating pain and another part of the special insole for fixing the medicine to promote the medicine being completely absorbed by the affected part. Compared with medical fumigation and washing and medical soaking, the acting time of the insole is prolonged greatly, because the insole can be put inside a shoe or is directly tied at the heel after the shoe is put off, and the insole can continuously remedy for a whole day of twenty four hours. The insole has the characteristics of being simple for operating, being convenient for using, being comfortable for wearing, being economical, practical, safe and reliable.

title: Traditional Chinese drop pills for treating cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a new form of a traditional Chinese medicine compound and a preparation method thereof. The new form of traditional Chinese medicine compound is used for activating the circulation of blood, dissolving the blood stasis, promoting the restoration of consciousness, taking away the pain, dilating the blood vessel, increasing the coronary artery blood flow and treating the coronary heart disease and the cerebral arteriosclerosis. The preparation method of the traditional Chinese drop pills comprises the following steps: grinding szechuan lovage rhizome, safflower, alisma orientale, achyranthes, radix curcumae, polygala tenuifolia, rhizoma anemones altaicae, spina date seeds and liquorice powder into medical fine power of 150 mesh for later use adding water to decoct aalvia miltiorrhiza, red paeony root, prepared radix polygoni multiflori, barbary wolfberry fruit, kudzu-vine root and earthworm for 2 hours with a dynamic counter current extraction method, wherein the water is four times the total amount of the aalvia miltiorrhiza, the red paeony root, the prepared radix polygoni multiflori, the barbary wolfberry fruit, the kudzu-vine root and the earthworm filtering the decoction concentrating the filtered decoction into thick paste adding and evenly stirring the thick paste, the medical fine power and dear heart powder to molten polyethylene glycol 4000, wherein the proportion of the thick paste, the medical fine power and the dear heart powder to the molten polyethylene glycol 4000 is 4:7 uniformly mixing keeping the temperature of the mixture at 70 DEG C dripping the mixture into liquid paraffin at constant speed leaching the prepared traditional Chinese drop pills and wiping out the liquid paraffin. Test proves that the traditional Chinese drop pills are more markedly improved in the curative effect and the bioavailability than the original capsules.

title: Health-care seven-flavor drink for middle and aged people
abstract: The invention discloses a health-care seven-flavor drink for middle and aged people, which is characterized in that the main ingredients comprise: 3 grams of ginseng, 10 grams of dwarf lilyturf tuber, 20 grams of raidx astragali, 10 grams of Chinese angelica, 15 grams of medlar, 20 grams of tuber fleece flower root, 6 grams of liquoric root and the like. For treating patients with heart throb, palpitation, chest stuffiness and pain, shortness of breath and unsmooth pulse, salvia miltiorrhiza bunge, turmeric root-tuber, szechuan lovage rhizome, cassia twig and the like are added and for treating patients with symptoms of dizziness, lnsomnia and dreaminess and thready rapid pulse, date kernel, platycladi seed, dried longan pulp and the like are added. For treating patients wiht symptoms of thirst and drinking likeness, swift digestion with rapid hungering, frequent urination, emaciation, red tongue with scant liquid and thready rapid pulse, yam, mongolian snakegourd root, Chinese magnoliavine fruit, fragrant solomonseal rhizome, kudzu-vine root and the like are added for treating patients with blood pressure on the high side and symptoms of dizziness and the like, tall gastrodia tuber, gambir plant, twotooth achyranthes root, eucommia bark, cassia occidentalis and the like are added for treating people with high blood lipid, charred crataegus is added for patient with hemiplegia as a sequel of apoplexy, earthworm, suberect spatholobus stem, aristolochia heterophylla, kudzu-vine root are added and for treating patients with symptoms of aconuresis or frequent micturition with limp aching lumbus and knees and the like, sharpleaf galangal fruit, raspberry, cherokee rose fruit, yam, combined spicebush root and the like are added. The method for preparing the health-care seven-flavor drink for middle and aged people, comprises the following steps: mixing the medicaments together placing the mixture in a vessel and soaking the mixture in water for 20 minutes.

title: Chinese medicinal active anti-cancer vaccine and method of preparing the same
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese active cancer prevention vaccine which consists of the raw medicines with following weight proportion: 1 to 1.5g of notoginseng, 1 to 1.5g of dried human placenta, 1.5 to 3g of manyleaf paris rhizome, 1.5 to 3g of dogtooth violet, 3 to 6g of black nightshade, 3 to 6g of hedyotis diffusa, 3 to 6g of dandelion, 6 to 10g of nutgrass galingale rhizome, 6 to 10g of szechwan lovage rhizome, 6 to 10g of rhizoma atractylodis, 6 to 10g of cape jasmine, 6 to 10g of medicated leaven, 6 to 10g of yam and 6 to 10g of poria cocos. The preparation method of the vaccine comprises the following steps: 650 to 800ml of water is added to the raw medicines for soaking for 30 to 60 minutes under normal temperature, decoction on a dull fire is carried out, dregs are removed after boiling for 10 to 15 minutes and 150 to 200ml of liquor is obtained then 600 to 750ml of boiled water is added to the dregs for boiling for 10 to 15 minutes, then the dregs are removed and 100 to 150ml of liquor is obtained the liquors obtained in the twice decoctions are mixed evenly and the vaccine is obtained. The vaccine has the effects of promoting qi circulation, alleviating mental depression, replenishing essence, nourishing blood, activating blood, dissolving stasis, clearing heat-toxin, treating boils, dispersing accumulation of pathogen, eliminating dampness, clearing away phlegm and promoting digestion to remove stagnated food. By adopting the traditional Chinese prescription, the harm of radiotherapy and chemotherapy can be reduced, the immune function of human body can be improved, the pain of patients can be alleviated and cancer cells can be killed in addition, the traditional Chinese active cancer prevention vaccine has the advantages of convenient source obtaining and simple preparation technique, thereby being suitable to generalization and application.

title: Comparison of the responsiveness of symptomatic outcome measures in knee osteoarthritis.
journal: Arthritis care and research : the official journal of the Arthritis Health Professions Association
abstract: ObjectiveA number of international scientific societies have recommended a core set of domains to be systematically assessed in clinical research studies on osteoarthritis (OA), i.e., pain, function, and patient's overall assessment. This open, longitudinal, observational study compares the responsiveness of different symptomatic variables evaluating these 3 domains in knee OA.MethodsPatients were individuals with painful knee OA. The collected data were Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC) pain subscale (0-100) and WOMAC function subscale (0-100), Lequesne's index (0-100), pain after physical activities (visual analog scale [VAS] 100 mm), and patient's global assessment (VAS 100 mm). The procedure used was knee joint lovage. Time of collection was before and 1, 3, and 6 months after the lavage. Analysis was by comparison of the standardized response mean (mean of the changes/SD of the changes) in an intent-to-treat strategy after 1, 3, and 6 months using the jackknife method.ResultsImprovement in all dimensions of WOMAC subscale scores and VAS scores was observed at month 1. Lequesne's index was not responsive to change. The standardized response mean was moderate, ranging from 0.00 to 0.40. Comparison of the estimates of the standardized response means using the jackknife method showed a statistically significant difference between Lequesne's index and the WOMAC subscale for function, but not between VAS pain and the WOMAC subscale for pain.ConclusionMost of the evaluated variables have a moderate responsiveness. In knee OA, the WOMAC function scale seems to be more sensitive than Lequesne's index for detecting changes after symptomatic therapy.

title: Oral capsule for treating neck, waist and leg pain diseases and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an orally taken traditional Chinese medicine capsule special for treating neck, waist and leg pains caused by various causes, which comprises the following formulation by weight (in terms of preparing 1,000 granules of orally taken capsules as standard): 9 to 90 grams of wild celery, 9 to 90 grams of radix gentianae macrophyllae, 9 to 90 grams of parsnip, 3 to 30 grams of wild ginger, 12 to 120 grams of loranthus parasiticus, 9 to 90 grams of angelica, 9 to 90 grams of white paeony root, 8 to 80 grams of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 9 to 90 grams of prepared rhizome of rehmannia, 10 to 100 grams of eucommia bark, 10 to 100 grams of achyranthis root, 9 to 90 grams of desertliving cistanche, 12 to 120 grams of teasel root, 5 to 50 grams of cinnamon core, 12 to 120 grams of radix codonopsitis, 12 to 120 grams of hoantchy root, 6 to 60 grams of rhizoma gastrodiae, 12 to 120 grams of Chinese wolfberry, 10 to 100 grams of kudzuvine root, 10 to 100 grams of akebia stem, 10 to 100 grams of Atractylis ovata, 10 to 100 grams of clematis root, 6 to 60 grams of safflower, 6 to 60 grams of cortex moutan, 6 to 60 grams of libanotus, 6 to 60 grams of myrrh, 10 to 100 grams of papaya, 12 to 120 grams of rhizoma drynariae, 12 to 120 grams of caulis milletiae, 10 to 100 grams of notoginseng, 10 to 100 grams of ophidian, 9 to 90 grams of scorpion, 2 to 15 chilopod, 10 to 100 grams of daemonorops draco, 12 to 120 grams of eupolyphaga, and 0 to 30 grams of radix glycyrrhizae preparata and the quality of the 36 gouts of traditional Chinese medicine accords with prescription of Chinese pharmacopoeia, and the components are prepared into powder according to a preparation method for the traditional Chinese medicine, and canned into capsules.

title: Pure traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating female sterility and pure traditional Chinese medicine preparation prepared thereby
abstract: The invention provides a pure traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating female sterility, comprising the following medicines by parts by weight: 12-20 parts of Chinese angelica, 5-10 parts of Szechuan lovage rhizome, 8-10 parts of stir-fried white paeony root, 12-20 parts of raw rehmannia root, 8-10 parts of red ginseng, 8-10 parts of stir-fried largehead atractylodes rhizome, 6-10 parts of peppermint, 5-10 parts of liquoric root, 8-10 parts of Chinese thorowax root, 3-6 parts of largetrifoliolious bugbane rhizome, 5-8 parts of baical skullcap root, 6-10 parts of Indian buead, 8-10 parts of hiraute shiny bugleweed herb, 6-10 parts of tree peony bark, 15-25 parts of motherwort herb, 5-10 parts of tangerine peel, 5-10 parts of stir-fried nutgrass galingale rhizome, 15-25 parts of danshen root, 12-20 parts of India madder root, 15-25 parts of membranous milkvetch root, 12-20 parts of Chinese wolfberry root-bark, 8-10 parts of yanhusuo, 8-10 parts of stir-fried combined spicebush root, 8-10 parts of starwort root, 15-25 parts of cuttlefish bone, 8-10 parts of cape jasmine fruit, 8-10 parts of blackend swallowwort root, 8-10 parts of rose, 8-10 parts of Chinese rose flower and 15-25 parts of tangerine leaf. The invention further provides a pure traditional Chinese medicine preparation prepared thereby. The pure traditional Chinese medicine composition has the effects of warmly nourishing liver and kidney, benefiting qi, nourishing blood, promoting blood circulation, removing blood stasis, dissipating phlegm, removing dampness, dispersing stagnated liver qi and relieving qi stagnation and can effectively treat irregular menstruation, amenorrhea, lower abdominal pain, hectic fever and sterility moreover, the pure traditional Chinese medicine preparation has simple preparation, low production cost and convenient administration.
